6913e6f7785c222b2c0eb094 description: So I looked over your report on the Rogue base. The commanders have been wanting to launch an assault on their compound for a while, and with this report, they're feeling confident they can make it work. I'm not convinced it'll work out without some support. I need you to keep a watchful eye over my men. If it was up to me I would just have you do it, but it's not. I'm arranging mortar support ahead of the assault so those Rogues will keep their heads down, I need you to make sure those emplacements don't tear the assault force in half before they even reach the base. You do that, and I'll sneak some extra goods for you.
6913e6f7785c222b2c0eb094 startedMessageT: Come in soldier, there's some plans in the work.
6913e6f7785c222b2c0eb094 successMessageT: I just got the word, seems the operation went smoothly. Thank you for the support!
6913e6f7785c222b2c0eb094 failMessageText: Fuck, what happened? Did anyone even make it out alive? You had one job, now you're in deep shit!
6913e6f7785c222b2c0eb094 acceptPlayerMes: Good, I'm feeling a lot better about this operation. Scouts have already found a route to get you to the mountain above the base, all you need to is follow this map and wait for the mortars. Take those emplacements out first, and anyone else you can. Just keep your distance from the assault force.
6913e6f7785c222b2c0eb094 completePlayerM: Here's the stuff I promised you. My men also included some gifts, a personal thank you for keeping their asses safe.
